verdict.rationale: Docs confirm hardware can be ordered, registered, and configured directly from the Dashboard (docs-32, docs-5, docs-20, docs-44) and that no-code options let a business start accepting payments immediately without building an integration (docs-21, docs-26, docs-31, docs-46). However, there is no evidence in the pack about the account sign-up/approval flow, KYC/underwriting timelines, or shipping speed that would substantiate 'approved and taking payments the same week.' missing for 10: evidence on account approval/underwriting turnaround, hardware shipping/delivery timelines, and independent confirmation of a same-week setup experience.
